entries.speaker: Agency Employee
entries.en: And don't pull a stunt like that[n]again, okay?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Okay... I won't...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What's going on here?

entries.speaker: Agency Employee
entries.en: Oh, uhh...

entries.speaker: Agency Employee
entries.en: Oh right, you fell victim to it too.[n]Is it okay if I tell her, Mika-chan?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.speaker: Agency Employee
entries.en: Do you remember a while back[n]when a bunch of models weren't[n]showing up to our shoots?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah, I remember.

entries.speaker: Agency Employee
entries.en: Well, apparently Mika-chan was[n]posing as our agency and telling[n]them the shoot locations changed.

entries.speaker: Agency Employee
entries.en: We had heard rumors that she might have[n]been doing it... but we thought people[n]were just jealous of her.

entries.speaker: Agency Employee
entries.en: I mean, those shoots she filled in[n]for really boosted her popularity.

entries.speaker: Agency Employee
entries.en: Anyway, I asked her about it today...[n]and all she had to say was "I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: What I did was really terrible. I caused[n]so much trouble for everyone...

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: But I'm gonna start working even[n]harder from now on, I promise...

entries.speaker: Agency Employee
entries.en: *sigh*

entries.speaker: Agency Employee
entries.en: Anyway, let's get started.[n]You're ready to go, right?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Yup!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...You really did something that lame?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: What are you calling lame?

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: This industry's overflowing with models.[n]Without an in, your career will never[n]even get off the ground.

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Chances don't come to those who[n]wait. You have to make your own[n]luck if you want to succeed.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You really are something...

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: It's your own fault for getting the boot.[n]If you can't crawl your way back up,[n]you may as well go home.

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: And either way, it's not like I'm[n]not talented. I just needed my shot,[n]and now I'm selling like crazy.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...You talk big, but they still found out[n]about your fake emails.

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Sure, but all I had to do was offer[n]a teensy apology. It would've been[n]dumb to try and hide it from them.

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Anyway, they can't sack me now. I'm gonna[n]get even more popular, even if it means[n]being detested for my actions.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *giggle*

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're just like the villains I used[n]to admire when I was a kid.[n]Beautiful, strong... and wicked.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Honestly, I just can't bring myself to[n]hate you.

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Well I don't have any trouble hating you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sorry Mika, but your hard work is only[n]gonna get you to second place.[n]I'm going to be the number one model.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You might be more popular right[n]now, but I'll take that spot from[n]you fair and square.

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: Hm...

entries.speaker: Mika
entries.en: All right then, I won't pull any more tricks.[n]I'll beat you with beauty... fair and square.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sounds good to me!
The photoshoot started...
Ann and Mika are both[n]beaming at the camera...

entries.speaker: Cameraman
entries.en: Yeah, that's it! This way!

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Man
entries.en: Hey, isn't that Mika? Wow,[n]she's even prettier in person.

entries.speaker: College Girl
entries.en: It's Mika! Oh, and Ann too![n]They're both so cute...!

entries.speaker: Long-Haired Woman
entries.en: What must they eat to have bodies[n]like that? The world is so unfair...

entries.speaker: College Girl
entries.en: They might have some natural[n]beauty, but they've gotta be[n]exercising to have those bods!

entries.speaker: Cameraman
entries.en: Wow, what a pose! Give me a[n]few more, just like that!

entries.speaker: Magazine Employee
entries.en: Something's changed in Ann-chan, huh?

entries.speaker: Assistant
entries.en: Yeah, she's really amped up the sexiness.[n]Maybe she's gained some confidence?

entries.speaker: Photoshoot Assistant
entries.en: All right, let's take five here.[n]Go get changed, Mika-chan.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Man, this is so fun! Today has[n]been really great so far!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So... how was I?
You really gave it your all.[clr 27]
You still have a ways to go.
Everyone was complimenting you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, yeah! I had to work extra[n]hard with you watching, [fName]!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't be so tough on me! I thought[n]I was doing pretty well, actually...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: R-Really!? That's awesome!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's kinda hard for me to tell...[n]but I guess I've changed, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I know I said I want to be the number[n]one model, but I'm okay with that not[n]happening just yet.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: For now, I just want to keep[n]improving, one step at a time.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Then someday down the line, I'll be[n]able to look at myself with pride.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hopefully people will see that confidence,[n]and draw strength from it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm gonna be a ray of light for[n]the people of this planet...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Just like you and Shiho are for me...
That's so embarrassing.
I'll be there with you.
You can do it, Ann.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *giggle* But... it's true.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah! Forever, okay?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, you're right. Thanks!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: [fName], you're... my light.

entries.speaker: Photoshoot Assistant
entries.en: All right, break time's over![n]Ann-chan, you're gonna be the[n]main focus for this session!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Got it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, let's hang out a little more[n]once the shoot ends, okay?
